newsitem.title: UK: UK power watchdog publishes supply quality reports.
newsitem.headline: UK power watchdog publishes supply quality reports.

text.p: Britain's electricity industry watchdog Offer said on Monday that it had published reports on quality of supply submitted by electricity companies.
Offer head Stephen Littlechild said in October 1995 that he intended to make these reports public and asked companies to include targets for the remainder of the current pricing period.
Littlechild said in a statement that the reports would help understanding of the relationship between capital expenditure and quality of supply.
"It will be necessary to consider these factors in appraising capital expenditure and in setting future price controls," Littlechild said. -- London Newsroom +44171 542 7717
